The bowl looks like a large oval salad bowl, about 20–24 cm across, so I scaled from that rather than the default 15 cm bowl.

- **Chicken:** There is a lot of diced cooked chicken, roughly 180–200 g. At about 165 kcal per 100 g, that comes to roughly 300 kcal.
- **Greens:** The arugula and spinach weigh about 40 g, around 10 kcal.
- **Broccoli:** About 30 g, around 10 kcal.
- **Oil or dressing:** None is clearly visible, though the chicken may have been cooked in a little oil, so I added about 30 kcal.

That gives roughly 350 kcal for about 260 g of food.
